# MCP 工具参考
<!-- AUTO-GENERATED by Tools/gen_docs.py - DO NOT EDIT BY HAND. -->

> 生成来源：`Server/ual_mcp/stdio_server.py`（`TOOL_DEFS`）与 `Server/ual_mcp/tools.py`（TOON 字段顺序）。MCP Server 只读连接 `.ual/index.duckdb`。

共 **4** 个工具。批量工具返回 TOON，单资产工具返回 YAML。

## `ual_search_assets`

Multi-funnel hybrid asset retrieval; returns compact TOON candidates + co-occurring bundle.

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | `string` | 否 |  | Natural-language keywords (DuckDB FTS BM25) |
| `asset_class` | `string` | 否 |  | e.g. AnimMontage, NiagaraSystem, StaticMesh |
| `filters` | `object` | 否 |  | Hard constraints: skeleton, duration_min/max, min/max_forward_cm, dominant_limb |
| `domain_scope` | `string` | 否 |  | Directory whitelist, e.g. /Game/Characters/Knight |
| `limit` | `integer` | 否 | `8` |  |

**返回**：TOON：section `candidates` + `co_occurring_bundle`

**实现**：`Server/ual_mcp/tools.py`

## `ual_inspect_asset`

Deep single-asset contract with semantic annotations; returns YAML.

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `string` | 是 |  | logical_id or asset_path |

**返回**：YAML：完整 AssetSpec（优先读 `assets.yaml_cache`）

**实现**：`Server/ual_common/yamlspec.py`

## `ual_get_cooccurring_bundle`

Co-occurrence graph bundle recommendation; returns TOON.

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `asset_path` | `string` | 是 |  |  |
| `top_k` | `integer` | 否 | `5` |  |

**返回**：TOON：section `co_occurring_bundle`

**实现**：`Server/ual_mcp/tools.py`

## `ual_find_similar_assets`

Deterministic 16-dim fingerprint duplicate detection; returns TOON.

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `asset_path` | `string` | 是 |  |  |
| `threshold` | `number` | 否 | `0.85` |  |

**返回**：TOON：section `similar_assets`

**实现**：`Server/ual_mcp/tools.py`

## TOON section 字段顺序

| section | 字段（顺序固定） |
| --- | --- |
| `candidates` | `logical_id`, `duration`, `forward_cm`, `strike_window`, `limb`, `score` |
| `co_occurring_bundle` | `logical_id`, `asset_class`, `weight`, `hint` |
| `similar_assets` | `logical_id`, `asset_class`, `similarity`, `shared_class` |

字段顺序与转义规则见 `docs/reference/protocol.md`。
